subject: Northstar Semiconductor
thesis: Demand visibility and operating leverage support continued earnings growth, but customer concentration limits conviction.

sources.title: Northstar FY2026 annual filing
sources.quote: Revenue increased 18 percent while gross margin expanded to 61 percent.

sources.title: Northstar fourth-quarter earnings call
sources.quote: Management expects accelerator backlog to convert over the next three quarters.

sources.title: 2026 accelerator supply-chain survey
sources.quote: Lead times remain elevated, though the rate of new orders slowed in July.

claims.counterevidence: The industry survey shows new-order momentum slowed in July.

claims.text: Gross margin reached 61 percent in FY2026.
claims.counterevidence: Supply constraints could increase expedite and input costs.

claims.text: Current backlog is likely to support three quarters of accelerator shipments.

risks: A small number of customers account for a material share of revenue.
Accelerator order growth may normalize before backlog converts.
Export controls could restrict addressable markets.
